name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
steps: Set two kettlebells side by side between wide feet, hinge back at your hips with a flat spine, and grip both handles.
Press one kettlebell firmly into the floor for stability as you row the opposite kettlebell back toward your hip.
Lower the lifted kettlebell smoothly back to the floor without shifting your hips or rounding your back.
Switch hands immediately to row the other kettlebell, continuing to alternate arms smoothly.
tips: Actively push the grounded kettlebell into the floor to brace your torso and prevent twisting.
Pull each elbow back toward your hip rather than shrugging your shoulder toward your ear.
